s-1.ptxt: Remove Back Door Trim Panel Assembly Upper

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 4 clips and 4 claws, and remove the back door trim panel assembly upper.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Back Door Side Garnish LH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the pin of the package tray trim garnish hook.
Disengage the clips and claws, and remove the back door side garnish LH together with the package tray trim garnish hook.
Disengage the 2 claws and remove the package tray trim garnish hook.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Back Door Side Garnish RH

atten4.ptxt: Remove the RH side using the same procedure as for the LH side.

s2.ptxt: Insert a moulding remover at the position shown in the illustration, disengage the 4 claws as shown in the illustration, and remove the back door inside handle.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Back Door Trim Panel Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove clip (A).
Disengage the 11 clips in the order (1) to (3) shown in the illustration, and remove the back door trim panel assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Do not pull from the notch.

s2.ptxt: Tilt the back door trim panel assembly in the direction of arrow (1) and remove it in the direction of (2).

atten3.ptxt: Before removing, check that the back door trim panel assembly (part A) is not caught on the back door lock assembly.

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector.
Remove the 2 nuts and clamp.
Disengage the claws and pin, and remove the rear light assembly LH.
Disconnect the connector.
Remove the 3 bolts and back door lock assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Wiper Arm Head Cap

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear wiper arm head cap.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Wiper Arm & Blade Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear wiper arm nut and remove the rear wiper arm & blade assembly.
Disconnect the connector.
Remove the 3 bolts and remove the rear wiper motor assembly.
Remove the rear wiper motor grommet.
Remove the 2 plug hole covers.
Disconnect the connectors.
Remove the 4 nuts.
Disengage the clips and remove the rear spoiler assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Back Door Outside Garnish Assembly

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connectors.
Remove the 4 nuts and the back door outside garnish.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Antenna Cord Sub-assembly NO.4 (w/ HDD Navigation System)

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connectors.
Remove the 2 bolts.
Using a clip remover, disengage the 12 clamps and remove antenna cord NO.4.
